title: Sparkling shroomshake
content:
# Sparkling shroomshake

Type: Food | Internal ID: SparklingShroomshake | Source: Cauldron | Usage: Eating | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Sap x4, Vineberry cluster x2, Smoke puff x2, Magecap x2 | Max Health: 30 | Max Stamina: 15 | Max Eitr: 90 | Duration: 25m | Healing: 4 hp/tick

# Introduction

Sparkling shroomshake is an Ashlands-tier food.

## Recipe

Sparkling shroomshake can be crafted at a level 6 Cauldron with:
• 4 Sap
• 2 Vineberry cluster
• 2 Smoke puff
• 2 Magecap

## Notes

• Sparkling shroomshake provides the second highest eitr gain in the game at 90, second to Marinated greens at 95.

Categorias: Food, Cooking recipes
